listingTitle: Compile constant Java patterns outside loops
title: Compile constant Java patterns outside loops
why: Pattern.compile parses and compiles the expression, so repeating it for every iteration adds avoidable CPU work and allocation.
suggestion: Compile the literal once before the loop or store it in a static final Pattern.
limitations: Only direct Pattern.compile calls with a string literal inside braced loops are reported.
Aliases, wrappers, text blocks, and dynamically computed patterns are not inferred.
